questions.text: In a single-phase full-bridge inverter using IGBTs, the switch opens while driving an inductive load. What is the primary function of the freewheeling diode (or body diode) connected anti-parallel to the switch?

options.label: A
options.text: To increase the switching frequency for better efficiency

options.label: B
options.text: To block reverse voltage from the DC source

options.label: C
options.text: To provide a path for inductive current and prevent high-voltage spikes

options.label: D
options.text: To act as a capacitor to smooth the output ripple

questions.solution: Correct answer: To provide a path for inductive current and prevent high-voltage spikes.

questions.text: The P–T–t path of the Greater Himalayan Sequence (GHS) shows a clockwise trajectory with peak metamorphism at ~25 Ma followed by near-isothermal decompression. Which structural feature is directly associated with the exhumation (decompression) phase of this path?

options.label: B
options.text: South Tibetan Detachment System (STDS)

options.label: C

options.label: D
options.text: Himalayan Frontal Thrust (HFT)

questions.solution: Correct answer: South Tibetan Detachment System (STDS).

questions.text: In the dual-register annotation technique for analysing Malayalam poetry, what is the correct sequence of steps when applying both Sanskrit aesthetics and modern critical theory to a prescribed text?

questions.text: In the critical editions of Bodo poetry, what specific orthographic problem arises from the representation of the high central vowel /ɨ/ during the script transition from Roman to Devanagari?

questions.text: As per the table below showing Budget Estimates (BE) 2024-25 for Major Subsidies (in Rs Lakh Crore), what is the approximate percentage share of Food Subsidy in the total Major Subsidies? | Subsidy Type | Allocation (Rs Lakh Crore) | | :--- | :--- | | Food Subsidy | 2.05 | | Fertilizer Subsidy | 1.64 | | Petroleum Subsidy | 0.12 | | **Total Major Subsidies** | **3.81** |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Approximate the fraction 2.05/3.81. Round to 2.0/3.8 = 20/38 = 10/19. Since 10/20 = 50%, and denominator is slightly smaller (19), the value is slightly above 50%. Only 54% fits. Step-by-step: Total Major Subsidies = 3.81 Lakh Cr. Food Subsidy = 2.05 Lakh Cr. Percentage = (2.05 / 3.81) * 100. Calculate 2.05/3.81 ≈ 0.538. 0.538 * 100 = 53.8% ≈ 54%.
